translations.web: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.
translations.bsb: “Your servant our father is well,” they answered. “He is still alive.” And they bowed down to honor him.
translations.kjv: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
translations.asv: And they said, Thy servant our father is well, he is yet alive. And they bowed the head, and made obeisance.
